capabilities: Open the editor at the source position of double-clicked reading-view content
Verify the Markdown source position before switching views
Resolve headings, text, and formulas, including inside callouts, quotes, lists, tables, and code blocks
Open verified formulas at their first $ and preserve the view when verification fails
disambiguation: Not a reading-mode enhancer or annotator; it only jumps from Reading view to the matching Markdown source position for editing.
extras: Requires Obsidian desktop 1.15.1 or later; the README warns to disable or pause other plugins that handle Reading-view double-clicks, and states all position matching is local with no network requests or telemetry. Manual installation steps are documented.
intentEvidence: inspired by Click to Edit. This plugin is an independent implementation that uses Obsidian's section information
problem: In Reading view, double-clicked elements keep their default interactions and there is no reliable way to jump to the exact Markdown source position of the text you are reading.

relations.evidence: The double-click workflow was inspired by Click to Edit.

summary: Reading-view helper that opens the editor at the verified Markdown source position of text, headings, or formulas you double-click.
